hero.eyebrow: No credit card. Free trial. Public link ready.
hero.title: Create Voice Campaigns in 60 Seconds
hero.subtitle: Launch a public campaign from Facebook, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Instagram, Google Ads, or a QR code without forcing visitors into an admin dashboard first.

product.title: Create and publish your campaign in 60 seconds, then grow it with proof.
product.subtitle: Voiceup brings campaign creation, supporter collection, routing, operations, messaging, CRM, reporting, and clear upgrade controls into one global product.

aiCopilot.title: AI Campaign Copilot
aiCopilot.text: Turn a rough issue into a campaign title, petition copy, authority letter, supporter update, and social post so you can publish in 60 seconds.

campaignStudio.title: Campaign Studio
campaignStudio.text: Create a public campaign workspace with templates, location governance, signer fields, media, QR assets, and publish checks.

authorityIntelligence.title: Authority Intelligence
authorityIntelligence.text: Map a campaign to the right local, city, state, national, or global authority with routing context and submission notes.

fieldCollection.title: Field Collection
fieldCollection.text: Collect signatures from phones, QR posters, paper forms, and field volunteers while keeping every supporter traceable.

movementCrm.title: Movement CRM
movementCrm.text: Understand supporters, referrers, volunteers, ambassadors, and local clusters so a petition becomes an organized movement.

commandCenter.title: Command Center
commandCenter.text: Coordinate campaign health, local momentum, authority follow-ups, field progress, and next actions from one dashboard.

communicationHub.title: Communication Hub
communicationHub.text: Prepare WhatsApp, SMS, email, and public updates for milestone announcements, volunteer nudges, and supporter follow-up.

reports.title: Reports and Petition Dossier
reports.text: Turn campaign activity into executive reports, location breakdowns, signer exports, and a petition dossier for submission.

workflow.title: From an issue to a polished petition campaign.
workflow.subtitle: A small team can start with a local problem, use AI to shape campaign content, publish a public link, collect support in the field, and hand a professional dossier to the right authority.
workflow.panelText: AI brief, location governance, signer fields, authority route, QR share, media, dossier.

demo.title: Watch how a campaign goes from idea to public launch.
demo.subtitle: Preview the Voiceup operating surface: launch, supporters, authority routing, sharing, reports, and upgrade paths after the first campaign is live.

trust.title: Designed for people who need momentum before management.
trust.subtitle: The first win is a working public campaign link. Admin, billing, analytics, branding, integrations, and team controls can come after users experience value.

fastCampaign.title: Fast first campaign
fastCampaign.text: Create and publish a campaign in 60 seconds with a public link, QR code, and share options.

publicTrust.title: Built for public trust
publicTrust.text: Every campaign can show the appeal, target authority, progress, consent text, and organizer context.

simplePowerful.title: Simple before powerful
simplePowerful.text: Start with one working campaign, then upgrade for larger teams, branding, communication, and reporting.

pricing.title: Start free, grow only when the campaign needs more power.
pricing.subtitle: Pick a plan for a small local campaign, a growing public movement, or an enterprise program. Upgrade paths support subscription, campaign-duration, supporter-count, feature-based, and custom quote models.

trial.title: Let people try Voiceup before they commit.
trial.subtitle: One campaign, limited supporter collection, Voiceup branding, and simple sharing tools. Ideal for a first campaign, a live launch, or testing whether the workflow fits the team.

faq.title: Built for teams that need trust before scale.

quickLaunch.question: Can a non-technical team launch a campaign quickly?
quickLaunch.answer: Yes. Voiceup is designed around guided setup, AI-assisted copy, templates, public links, QR sharing, and publish checks so teams can move fast.

freeTrial.question: Is the 1-day trial really free?
freeTrial.answer: The landing flow presents a 1-day free trial path for one campaign with Voiceup branding and limited supporter collection. Paid upgrades can be configured when the team is ready.

offlineSupport.question: Can campaigns collect support offline?
offlineSupport.answer: Yes. Voiceup supports online signatures, QR-based collection, and paper/scan workflows for field teams and community events.

outsideIndia.question: Does Voiceup work outside India?
outsideIndia.answer: Yes. Global mode supports country, state or province, city or district, locality or ward, and postal/ZIP fields while India detailed mode remains available.

smallOrganization.question: Can pricing fit a small organization?
smallOrganization.answer: Yes. The plan ladder starts with a free trial and Starter plan, then grows into Growth, Pro Movement, and Enterprise options as campaign scale increases.

finalCta.title: Launch the first campaign, show the value, then choose the plan that fits.
finalCta.subtitle: Voiceup helps people promote their campaign from a real public link: AI campaign copy, field collection, movement CRM, communication hub, and impact reports in one place.

footer.tagline: Voiceup Global, built for public campaigns worldwide.
